spans.s: 1. मुच् cl. 1. Ā. मोचते, to cheat, Dhātup. vi, 12 (= √ मच्, q.v.)

etym.s: [cf. Gk. μύσσω, μῦκος, μυκτής; Lat. mungo, mucus.]

spans.s: 3. मुच् mfn. freeing or delivering from (see अंहो-म्˚)
letting go or letting fall, dropping, discharging, shooting, sending (see जल-, पर्ण-, सायक-म्˚ &c.)
N. of a Nāga (who sheltered the Buddha from a violent storm by coiling himself round him), Lalit.;
of the sacred tree protected by this Nāga (under which B˚ seated himself),
of an ancient king (or Muni), MBh.; BhP.
of a son of Māndhātṛ (who assisted the gods in their wars with the demons and was rewarded by the boon of a long and unbroken sleep), MBh.; Pur.
of a son of Yadu, Hariv.
of the father of Candra-bhāga, Cat.
of a poet of Kāśmīra, ib.
मुचुकुन्द—कवि m. the poet Mucukunda, Bhojapr.
मुचुकुन्द—प्रसादक m. N. of Kṛṣṇa, Pañcar.
a kind of big orange, L. (cf. मुचलिन्द and मुचिलिन्द).
pl. N. of a people, ŚāṅkhŚr.
